$comment: Gzip ceilings in KB (1 KB = 1024 bytes) for the deployable dist/. Enforced by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs, which runs in `npm run check` and gates CI. `initial` is every asset dist/index.html loads eagerly — the critical path for first paint. `deferred` is loaded on demand (atlas chunks on birthplace search, knowledge pack on version negotiation) so it must not count against first paint, but is still capped. Raising a ceiling is a deliberate, reviewable act: rerun with --update and commit the diff.
